common.copyLink: Or copy and paste this link into your browser:

verification.subject: Welcome to Tududi - Verify your email
verification.opening: Thank you for registering. To complete your registration and start using Tududi, please verify your email address by clicking the link below:
verification.expires_one: This verification link will expire in {{count}} hour.
verification.expires_other: This verification link will expire in {{count}} hours.
verification.trial_one: Verifying also starts your free {{count}}-day trial, no card needed. It includes the AI assistant with a smaller allowance and one member you can add, such as a partner or a teammate. Public note links open once you subscribe.
verification.trial_other: Verifying also starts your free {{count}}-day trial, no card needed. It includes the AI assistant with a smaller allowance and one member you can add, such as a partner or a teammate. Public note links open once you subscribe.
verification.benefitsIntro: After verification, you'll be able to:
benefits: Create and organize tasks with ease
verification.ignore: If you didn't create an account with Tududi, you can safely ignore this email.

verificationReminder.subject: Reminder: verify your email to start using Tududi
verificationReminder.opening: You signed up for Tududi a day or so ago, but your email address is not verified yet. Your account (and your free trial) starts as soon as you verify it.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your Tududi password
passwordReset.intro: Someone asked to reset the password for your Tududi account.
passwordReset.action: Open this link to choose a new password:
passwordReset.expires_one: The link expires in {{count}} minute. If you did not ask for a reset, ignore this email; your password stays as it is.
passwordReset.expires_other: The link expires in {{count}} minutes. If you did not ask for a reset, ignore this email; your password stays as it is.

memberInvite.subject: You have been added to a Tududi workspace
memberInvite.intro: You have been added to a Tududi workspace.
memberInvite.action: Choose a password to activate your account and sign in:
memberInvite.expires_one: The link expires in {{count}} hour. If you were not expecting this, you can ignore this email.
memberInvite.expires_other: The link expires in {{count}} hours. If you were not expecting this, you can ignore this email.

trialReminder.subjectDays_one: Your tududi trial ends in {{count}} day
trialReminder.subjectDays_other: Your tududi trial ends in {{count}} days
trialReminder.endsTomorrow: Your tududi Cloud trial ends tomorrow, on {{date}}.
trialReminder.endsInDays_one: Your tududi Cloud trial ends in {{count}} day, on {{date}}.
trialReminder.endsInDays_other: Your tududi Cloud trial ends in {{count}} days, on {{date}}.
trialReminder.afterReadOnly_one: After that your account turns read-only for {{count}} day, so you can still export your data, and is then deleted.
trialReminder.afterReadOnly_other: After that your account turns read-only for {{count}} days, so you can still export your data, and is then deleted.
trialReminder.afterFree: After that your account moves to the free plan.
trialReminder.keep: To keep using tududi Cloud as it is now, AI assistant and members included, subscribe:

deletionWarning.subject: Your tududi account will be deleted on {{date}}
deletionWarning.ended: Your tududi Cloud trial has ended, and your account has been read-only since then.
deletionWarning.deleteOn: On {{date}} the account and everything in it will be deleted.
deletionWarning.export: To take your data with you instead, export it from the Backup page:
deletionWarning.final: If you do nothing, the account is deleted on {{date}} and this is the last email you will get from us about it.

emptyAccount.subject: Your tududi is still empty
emptyAccount.intro: You have had a tududi account for a couple of days, but nothing is in it yet. Most people start with one of these, and each takes less than a minute:
ideas: Write down whatever is on your mind in the Inbox, and sort it out later.
Open Plan, pick three things for today, and leave the rest.
Make a project for something you keep putting off, and add its first step.
emptyAccount.outro: This is the only email like this we will send.

comeBack.subject: Your tasks are where you left them
comeBack.intro: You have not been in tududi for a while. Everything you added is still there, just as you left it.
comeBack.tip: If the list got too long, start small: open Plan, pick three things for today, and leave the rest for later.
comeBack.outro: We will not send another one of these until you have been back.
